348:t_000:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe it's because you've helped me be more positive, $n...」

348:t_000:76.en:
$n
「If that's all it is, that's fine.」

348:t_000:77.en:
$$カトル$$
「...Everyone, be careful. Something is approaching us...!」

348:t_000:78.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Anyone coming to a place like this is bound to be trouble.」

348:t_001:0.en:
$$ノイン$$
「It's the $$マリーメイア$$ Army...!」

348:t_001:1.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「That name no longer suits us, now that the little girl is gone.」

348:t_001:2.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「But the ideals we held then still live in our hearts.」

348:t_001:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「They haven't surrendered to $$ネオ・ジオン$$ or the Federation. They're still fighting for $$デキム・バートン$$'s ideals.」

348:t_001:5.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「That's right! The half-collapsed $$地球連邦$$ cannot stop us!」

348:t_001:6.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「We will build a new independent nation here on $$火星$$, without relying on $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

348:t_001:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Do you even understand the situation?」

348:t_001:9.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「That day... In the battle at $$ブリュッセル$$, you robbed us of our pride in creating a new world!」

348:t_001:10.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「We have no choice but to win if we are to reclaim that pride!」

348:t_001:11.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「To that end, we will occupy the settlements on $$火星$$ and make this planet ours!」

348:t_001:12.en:
$$五飛$$
「So it's winners and losers again... Why can't you break free of that...!?」

348:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I know. We won't let fools who confuse pride with ego do as they please with this new frontier!」

348:t_001:16.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「$c...! We hadn't counted on finding you here, but it seems your forces are depleted!」

348:t_001:17.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「We'll pay you back, too!」

348:t_001:20.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If that will satisfy you, I'll fight you.」

348:t_001:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin your attack! We'll put an end to $$デキム・バートン$$'s ambitions here, once and for all!」

348:t_002:0.en:
$$モーム$$
「Everyone, watch out! Enemy reinforcements are coming!」

348:t_002:1.en:
$$桂$$
「You sore losers just won't give up!」

348:t_003:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「I can't believe such a huge force has come...!」

348:t_003:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It looks like $$マリーメイア$$'s remnants from across the $$地球圏$$ are gathering on $$火星$$!」

348:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アン・アーレス$$! Is that $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!?」

348:t_005:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's this...? You're still struggling with these small fry?」

348:t_005:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Well... I just dropped by to play while I was out on an errand.」

348:t_005:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「So you were the one helping the $$マリーメイア$$ Army!」

348:t_005:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「You amplified their hatred and made them do this...!」

348:t_005:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, Earthlings. Yes, $$サイデリアル$$ brought them here, but...」

348:t_005:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Their hatred is entirely their own.」

348:t_005:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's what humans are like. Hatred leaves a deeper mark on their hearts than anything else.」

348:t_005:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Love is fulfilled and loses its value, or withers away unrequited... But hatred is eternal.」

348:t_005:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even if you kill or erase its object, once hatred takes root, it clings to your heart and stays with you forever.」

348:t_005:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You understand, don't you, $$ゼロ$$? And you, $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

348:t_005:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hatred clings to the depths of your hearts...! You keep it in check for now, but someday it will...」

348:t_005:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Shut up, $$バルビエル$$! I have no intention of listening to you!」

348:t_005:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...Fine. But you'll never win.」

348:t_005:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Those soldiers' hatred has grown with defeat, and now they'll swallow you whole!」

348:t_005:18.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「All units, charge! We have the momentum!」

348:t_005:19.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is behind us! Even $c's morale is low!」

348:t_005:20.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「This is bad, $$ゼロ$$. Taking on both them and $$バルビエル$$ is dangerous.」

348:t_005:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But retreating won't change anything. We must shield the residential district and...」

348:t_006:2.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「You scoundrels spread hatred without ever reflecting on your own folly!」

348:t_006:3.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Your cause has no justice worth upholding, nor any pride worth protecting!」

348:t_006:4.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「All you have is your petty ego!」

348:t_006:5.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「You dare say that...!?」

348:t_006:6.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「You're nothing but beaten dogs who wagged their tails for the establishment after your defeat!」

348:t_006:7.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes! We are shameless cowards who pinned our guilt on His Highness and lived on in comfort!」

348:t_006:8.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We have neither justice nor pride left! We can only devote ourselves to the future of the people His Highness died to protect!」

348:t_006:9.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Come! We will show you the resolve to face death that we inherited from His Highness!」

348:t_006:10.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「$c! Leave them to us and defeat $$サイデリアル$$!!」

348:t_006:11.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「All units, charge! Break through $c and crush those beaten dogs!」

348:t_007:1.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「This red land is our future!」

348:t_008:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Men with something to protect won't go down that easily.」

348:t_008:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you're worried, let's finish off $$サイデリアル$$ quickly and go help them.」

348:t_008:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Did you see that, $$バルビエル$$!? Some people resist hatred and risk their lives to do what they must!」

348:t_008:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't think the words of someone who surrendered to hatred, like you, can sway our hearts!」
